title: Sketchpad Double Click App Navigation
description: Double clicking a type or design from sketchpad VFS rows or wires nodes should navigate to the matching app, with design using Puzzle 5D.
summary: Aligned sketchpad route parsing and active app resolution with the singular /type/:id and /design/:id routes already emitted by VFS rows, wires activation, breadcrumbs, and selection query handling. Added regression coverage for type/design app resolution, route parsing, wires navigation, and updated existing browser expectations to singular routes. Verified focused tests, play build, and an in-browser runtime route/app check with [DEBUG] logs.
